title_hi: Targeted Attack Claims Life of 23-Year-Old in British Columbia
title_en: Targeted Attack Claims Life of 23-Year-Old in British Columbia
content_hi: A 23-year-old man of Punjab origin was fatally shot in Langley, British Columbia, in what authorities believe was a targeted attack. The incident occurred outside a commercial complex, and investigators are exploring a possible connection to a vehicle that was found burning shortly after the shooting. The Integrated Homicide Investigation Team is leading the inquiry, which may involve gang-related activities. As of now, no suspects have been identified. This tragic event raises concerns about safety and gang violence in the area. . News Wire 24 ki vishleshan team dwara.

title_hi: Maharashtra Times Culture Club grows community to over 3 lakh
title_en: Maharashtra Times Culture Club grows community to over 3 lakh
content_hi: Maharashtra Times Culture Club (MTCC), a community initiative by Maharashtra Times, has crossed 3 lakh members, bringing together Marathi-speaking audiences interested in art, music, theatre, heritage, sports and other cultural areas. The club offers members access to curated experiences, events, workshops and networking opportunities. Its programming covers entertainment, culture, learning and personal development throughout the year. Music is a key part of the club’s programming, with MTCC organising live concerts featuring artists and musical groups. The club also runs Natyamahotsav, an annual Marathi theatre festival featuring three to four plays each year. The festival attracts more than 1,000 theatre enthusiasts annually. Beyond entertainment, MTCC organises workshops focused on learning and skill development. Past sessions have covered calligraphy, cooking, fashion designing and advertising photography. The community has members across Mumbai, Pune and other urban and tier-2 markets in Maharashtra. It also offers brands opportunities to integrate with its live events, festivals, workshops and other curated experiences. MTCC plans to expand its programming across culture, entertainment, learning and lifestyle as its community grows. (afaqs! got this information in a press release) .
